scope: Specific inspected code defects; original finite facts retained where valid.

entries.observed_code: dyn compares truth(a,b,q) to itself; fixed competitors are only a and b.
entries.established_scope: A binary multiplexer exactly solves its supplied truth table and two fixed-coordinate baselines miss cases.
entries.unsupported_promotion: Derivation of dot-product attention or full Transformer.
entries.repair_obligation: Supply score/normalization/readout assumptions and compare explicit resource-matched competitors.

entries.observed_code: step=lambda d:max(d-1,0); only step(2), step(step(2)), step(1) are checked.
entries.established_scope: Two scalar decrement steps suffice on one input.
entries.unsupported_promotion: Derivation of stochastic diffusion/denoising or a generative distribution.
entries.repair_obligation: Define normalized stochastic kernels, schedule and trained objective.

entries.observed_code: The profiles table assigns A and B error4 cost3, HYBRID error0 cost5.
entries.established_scope: Only the supplied HYBRID profile satisfies supplied zero-error viability.
entries.unsupported_promotion: A task-derived theorem of hybrid superiority.
entries.repair_obligation: Compute profiles from independently specified tasks and implementations.

entries.observed_code: Checks local XOR under rotations of four bits.
entries.established_scope: This particular Boolean map is equivariant on the tested finite domain.
entries.unsupported_promotion: Necessity or optimality of convolutional architecture.
entries.repair_obligation: Specify linearity, group action, locality and task/resource assumptions.

entries.observed_code: Delay transducer enumeration and one supplied conditional XNOR rule.
entries.established_scope: Finite delay-state requirement and a conditional Boolean realization.
entries.unsupported_promotion: Learning recurrence/gates or superiority of tree induction.
entries.repair_obligation: Separate state-memory lower bound, gate form, learned updates and induction method.

entries.observed_code: branch_value immediately calls world_value; run compares it back to world_value.
entries.established_scope: The alias returns the same function output.
entries.unsupported_promotion: Independent derivation or independent semantic verification.
entries.repair_obligation: Use a distinct implementation or derivation and test semantic agreement.

entries.observed_code: Knots are fixed at -8 and 8; candidates are TABLE/BRANCH/AFFINE/HINGE with supplied costs.
entries.established_scope: A piecewise-affine identity plus selection among four supplied representation classes under two supplied tariffs.
entries.unsupported_promotion: Prior-free synthesis, unknown-family discovery, measured hardware superiority or training generalization.
entries.repair_obligation: Disclose supplied classes, primitives, knots and tariffs; new discovery requires an actual search protocol and independent outcomes.

entries.observed_code: A forbidden-word list is checked in source text.
entries.established_scope: The listed words do not occur.
entries.repair_obligation: Audit generator, primitives, candidate grammar and selection objectives; names alone cannot certify blindness.

entries.observed_code: Tests include all(t==t...), constant-zero loss and one four-action planning table.
entries.established_scope: Declared two-bit quotient, constant-collapse and finite planning witnesses.
entries.unsupported_promotion: A learned latent is sufficient for controlled planning.
entries.repair_obligation: T1/T2 provide a conditional repair; measure/verify reward and action-conditioned transition compatibility.

entries.observed_code: Validates names, row counts, verdict vocabulary and two scaling labels without implication/theorem witnesses.
entries.established_scope: Registry schema and selected claim-boundary consistency.
entries.unsupported_promotion: Truth of DERIVED or CONDITIONALLY_EXPLAINED verdicts.
entries.repair_obligation: Require explicit assumptions, proof/source locator, semantic map and appropriate evidence level.
